title: Term Life Insurance Free-Look Periods
content:
Every Term Life Insurance tier gives the owner a free-look period counted in calendar days from the policy delivery date.

| Sale | Free-look period (all tiers: Ashgrove Annual Renewable Term; Ashgrove Level Term 10, 15, 20, 25, 30) |
|---|---|
| Ordinary sale | 10 calendar days |
| Sale that replaced existing coverage | 30 calendar days |

Hypothetical: a policy delivered on 1 March in an ordinary sale has a free-look end of 11 March; in a replacement sale the end is 31 March.
